$comment: Advisories we cannot fix yet, each with why and until when. Past `until`, the scan fails again and the entry must be re-checked.

accepted.why: Comes in through pkarr -> mainline, which pins lru 0.16. Needs an upstream release; we never call LruCache::pop ourselves.

Dev-only, via micromatch in the build and lint tooling (both lockfiles). The patterns it expands are the repository's own globs, never input from a person or a peer. No fixed release exists yet (3.0.3 is the latest and is affected).

0.10.x has no fixed release; 0.12.1 is a new line behind digest 0.11. 0.10.4 comes in through sha2 0.10 (tauri-codegen at build time, wry) and hmac/md-5/sha1 under rtc-crypto (Linux webrtc). Needs those to move to digest 0.11. The bug needs a panic inside the hash compress step to be caught, which these hashes never raise.

Only for the zod 3.25.76 copies nested under @atproto/* in package-lock.json (Bluesky sign-in in packages/browser and packages/cli). 3.25.76 is the last 3.x and every @atproto release still requires zod ^3.23.8. They parse answers from the Bluesky server the person signs in to. The website copy is on 4.6.7.
Unmaintained proc-macro, build-time only, via iroh -> netwatch -> netlink-packet-core. No known vulnerability.

zip via tauri-plugin-updater; dependency update scheduled in the next patch. The updater extracts a zip only on Windows, and only after the download passes the signature check against the release key in apps/desktop/tauri.conf.json.

Unmaintained, not vulnerable: merged into zbus 6.0.0 (2026-10-16). Linux D-Bus only, via zbus 5 in apps/desktop and in notify-rust, tauri-plugin-notification and tauri-plugin-single-instance, whose latest releases still require zbus 5. Move to zbus 6 when they do.
